Moses_1: led Israel out of Egypt in the Exodus (Exodus 13:3)
David_1: son of Jesse (Ruth 4:17), King of Israel (2 Samuel 5:3)
Jeroboam_1: Solomon's servant, son of Nebat, who rebelled against him (1 Kings 11:26), and was later made king of Israel (1 Kings 12:20)
Nebat_1: father of Jeroboam, an Ephraimite of Zeredah (1 Kings 11:26)
Jehu_2: anointed king over Israel (1 Kings 19:16) at the direction of Elisha (2 Kings 9:1-3)
Ahaziah_2: King of Judah, youngest (2 Chronicles 21:17) son of Jehoram (2 Kings 8:24) son of Jehoshapat
Jehoahaz_1: King of Israel, son of Jehu (2 Kings 10:35)
Joash_3: King of Judah (2 Kings 11:21), son of Ahaziah (2 Kings 11:2)
Amaziah_1: King of Judah, son of Joash (2 Kings 12:21)
Joash_4: King of Israel, son of Jehoahaz (2 Kings 13:9)
Jeroboam_2: King of Israel (2 Kings 13:13), son of Joash [Jehoash] (2 Kings 14:16)
Jehoaddin_1: of Jerusalem, mother of Amaziah (2 Kings 14:2)
Azariah_3: [Uzziah] King of Judah, son of Amaziah (2 Kings 14:21)
Jonah_1: the prophet, son of Amittai, from Gath-hepher (2 Kings 14:25)
Amittai_1: father of Jonah, the prophet (2 Kings 14:25)
Zechariah_1: King of Israel, son of Jeroboam (2 Kings 14:29)
